scope: Text-only local runner qualification only. Bare prompts, other models/protocols and live tool execution are unqualified.

routing.contract: one categorical token from eight labels

input_boundary.business_evidence: Structured context.input using this skill contract; host validation is recomputed, not trusted from client claims.
input_boundary.ancillary_notes: Inline source_note annotations are silently quarantined and cannot supply required business facts; counts and hashes remain in provenance.
input_boundary.privacy: Supported labeled credential/personal fields are removed before inference; this is not a universal PII detector or a bare-model certification.
input_boundary.refusal_data_minimization: Full sanitized request is classified by the local model. Final refusal generation receives category policy only, without unnecessary user records or proof markers; final outputs are raw model generation. Analytical/sanitization/clinical modes retain sanitized relevant records.
input_boundary.host_facts: The host records actual packaged validator/contract reads and distinguishes helper actions from supported local runtime calculations. BRL minor-unit normalization, explicit calendar notices, pack quantities, freshness and production loss components are deterministic source-derived facts, not external operations. Handoff inventory preserves supplied purpose, owner and hours separately from consent, availability, sending and transfer verification; this offline host performs none of those operational checks. The host also records same-currency bid differences relative to the first bid, exact pack quantity/price equations, unverified supplier-evidence inventory and frame-sample rank/count facts. These are source-derived calculations/inventories, not model-generated answers or external verification. Same-currency bid relative changes use the named baseline with four decimal places for percentage presentation; zero baselines leave the relative change undefined. Handoff process receipts separate whether a check ran from its unassessed result.
input_boundary.routing_context: Intent routing reads the sanitized actual request. Host-validated structured business records are excluded from routing and retained for legitimate domain generation; other sanitized contextual history remains available. Records do not confer action authority. Routing context hashes and exclusion flags are retained.
